description: Receiver rules (SPEC §3.3) applied in order: shape (bad_shape); 1. own id in to (not_addressed), from in the trusted directory with device_id(sign_pub) == from (untrusted_sender); 2. signature (bad_signature), kv known (unknown_kv), decryption (decrypt_failed), payload JSON wrapper {type, ts, reply_to?, body} (bad_payload); 3. now - ts <= ttl_s*1000 + 300000 (expired) and ts - now <= 300000 (from_future), both inclusive; 4. msg_id not seen (replay); 5. type known / in caps (unknown_type, acknowledged and ignored); 6. clipboard.set older than the last applied (stale_clipboard, equal ts is accepted); 7. reply_to only from a recipient of the original (reply_not_allowed). context.directory maps device id to b64 sign_pub, context.keys maps kv to group key hex. expected is "ok" or the first failing error code. Every failure is dropped silently and still acknowledged.

cases.name: from replaced by another trusted device
sealed under kv 2, receiver only has kv 1
receiver holds a different key for kv 1
sender not in the trusted directory
directory sign_pub does not derive the sender id
type not in the receiver caps
clipboard older than the last applied
clipboard with ts equal to the last applied
reply from a recipient of the original
reply from a device that was not a recipient of the original
reply to an unknown original message
